• Fabric & feel: Lightweight beachwear fabric with a soft pleated look on the dresses and matching ombre shorts for boys and dads.
  • Family story: A bright vacation-ready look for moms, dads, girls, and boys in one sunset ombre palette.
  • Print: Pink, blue, and green gradient color gives the outfit a cheerful beach-photo finish.

  • Care: Hand wash or machine wash cold on gentle, line dry, do not bleach, and steam lightly if needed.
  • Size range: Child 2 Years through Child 12 Years; Mother S-4XL; Father S-4XL.

The Sunset Ombre Family Matching Set is designed for easy resort photos, beach mornings, cruises, and warm-weather family plans. The color story moves from pink into ocean blue and soft green, so the whole family feels coordinated without every person wearing the same piece.

Dresses for girls and mothers, shorts for boys and fathers; the T-shirt shown in photos is not included. Every size is listed in the size chart; waist and hip values are approximate.

Key Features:

  • Dress and shorts options: Choose the garment type for each family member.
  • Vacation-ready palette: Pink, blue, and green ombre color looks bright in outdoor family photos.
  • Role-bearing sizes: Size labels clearly separate Child, Mother, and Father sizes.
  • T-shirt not included: T-shirts are not included with your order.

Choose the dress or shorts size for each family member and build a colorful matching look for sunny trips, beach photos, and relaxed family days.

Morning Blooms makes a coordinated family look easy to build without forcing a bundled purchase. Choose the airy floral dress for girls and moms, or select the matching floral shorts for boys and dads, then add each family member's size separately.

Each piece is priced and selected independently by Type and Size, so the cart contains only the garment you choose. The size chart shows dress measurements plus shorts length and hip measurements for boys and men; shirt measurements are not listed.

Key Features:

  • Separate garment choices: Select Dress or Shorts by Type for each shopper.
  • Scattered floral: Petite multicolor blooms keep the ivory matching look photo-ready.
  • Easy family styling: Pair the shorts with your own white top, as shown in the photos.
  • Four-role sizing: Coordinated options span girl, mother, boy, and father size ranges.
  • Size chart: Every garment and size offered has its own row in the size chart.

Choose Dress or Shorts, select each family member's size, and build a Morning Blooms look for your next shared moment.

p3.descriptionHtml:
• Fabric: Exact fiber content was not provided; the source size chart identifies the garment as a sweatshirt.
  • Family story: One unisex crewneck sweatshirt for children and adults, ready for coordinated family photos, trips, and everyday matching.
  • Print reference: A smiling star and the word “SHINE” create a bright, playful family graphic.
  • Design details: Long sleeves, a crew neckline, ribbed trim, and a relaxed pullover shape. Pants, skirts, hats, glasses, shoes, and accessories shown in the image are styling only and are not included.
  • Care: Check the sewn-in care label first; when compatible, wash cold on gentle, use mild detergent, avoid bleach, and line dry.
  • Size range: Child 2 Years through Child 9-10 Years and Adult S through Adult 4XL.

Shine Star keeps the family look simple: choose each person’s size, then pick from White, Green, Blue, or Pink. The shared star graphic makes the colors feel coordinated while letting every family member choose a favorite.

The size chart shows garment length, chest, shoulder, sleeve, recommended height, and recommended weight. Weight ranges were converted from jin to kilograms. Because the source omits hip and waist, child hip is derived as chest plus 4 cm with waist equal to chest; adult hip equals chest and adult waist is chest minus 12 cm. Choose by the full chart and size up when between ranges or when a roomier fit is preferred.

Key Features:

  • Four requested colors: White, Green, Blue, and Pink are kept together in one product.
  • One family graphic: The same Shine star artwork coordinates child and adult sweatshirts.
  • Easy pullover shape: Long sleeves, a crew neckline, and ribbed trim create a casual layer.
  • Inclusive unisex sizing: Seven child sizes and seven adult sizes; see the size chart for measurements.
  • One sweatshirt per selection: Each selection includes one sweatshirt; all other pictured pieces and accessories are styling only.

Choose each family member’s size and color to build your own Shine Star matching look.

Rosewater Ombre gives mom-and-daughter dressing a soft, flowing finish with the same pink-to-white fade and fine pleated texture across both dress choices. Select each child or mother size separately to build the matching combination you need.

Each dress is sold separately. The cardigan, bags, shoes, and other styling accessories shown in the image are not included. Every available size has its own row in the size chart.

Key Features:

  • Mom + daughter match: Coordinated child and mother dresses in one ombre colorway.
  • Pink-to-white fade: A soft gradient keeps the matching look light and photo-ready.

  • Family size range: Seven child sizes and five mother sizes; see the size chart for measurements.
